registration r JOIN exam_session s ON s.id = r.session_id JOIN exam_project p ON p.id = r.project_id JOIN exam_subject sub ON sub.id = p.subject_id JOIN exam_site site ON site.id = r.site_id
r.id, r.registration_number, r.session_id, s.name AS session_name, sub.name AS subject_name, site.name AS site_name, s.exam_starts_at, r.submitted_at, r.status

r.id, r.registration_number, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(r.candidate_name_snapshot) <= 1 THEN '*' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(r.candidate_name_snapshot, 1), REPEAT('*', LEAST(CHAR_LENGTH(r.candidate_name_snapshot) - 1, 3))) END AS candidate_name, r.candidate_type_snapshot AS candidate_type, r.school_name_snapshot AS school_name, r.session_id, s.name AS session_name, sub.name AS subject_name, r.site_id, site.name AS site_name, r.submitted_at, r.status

AND (#{filter.sessionId} IS NULL OR r.session_id = #{filter.sessionId}) AND (#{filter.siteId} IS NULL OR r.site_id = #{filter.siteId}) AND (#{filter.candidateType} = '' OR r.candidate_type_snapshot = #{filter.candidateType}) AND (#{filter.status} = '' OR r.status = #{filter.status}) AND CONVERT(r.registration_number USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
